history.summary: The plan is complete: 11 phases, running the rulings-free work before the one pause at P5 and hosting last, and 20 criteria in verification.json. The dry run parses; its one problem is P8's gate on the new repo pvginkel/PipelinesDeploy, which planning created empty under D4. Three questions in plan_questions_r1.md: KubeCoderConfig's lint needs a `frontend` sidecar this environment lacks, whether the pipelines stage auto-syncs after the operator's first sync, and a placeholder manifest or a gate ruling for PipelinesDeploy.

The plan now carries rulings D5-D7 (AnsibleSpecs 204639e). P10 registers pipelines auto-synced the way charts is, so the site goes live in the test phase; V12 lost its owed_after and the run checks it; P7, P8, V14 and V16 follow. The placeholder manifest is pushed to PipelinesDeploy (d3b112a), and the dry run gates all 11 phases cleanly. No prd ruling covers the Architecture push, which redeploys the architecture viewer in prd; the plan cites that repo's push-as-you-go rule for it.

No ruling authorizes the test phase's pushes of Architecture (it redeploys prd, and the runbook's registration step is the operator's) and of JenkinsPipelineUtils (the standing each-push-needs-OK rule was dropped from the plan), or P8's hook on PipelinesDeploy. Only the operator can close that gap (F1). V07/P6 define the monorepo reference file as what the scripted ModernAppTemplate renders, against declarative-only and the full linter check (F2). Three advisory notes.

Rulings F1–F5 are applied (AnsibleSpecs 2a75881). The go-live pushes and P8's hook now cite D3/D6/F1. P4 lists the ten jobs of the five ModernAppTemplate repos as skipped, AaC jobs included, and P6 and V07 lose the monorepo reference file. P1 reads Manage hooks from /manage/configure (on today). P2 ships no guide page. J11's exceptions are proposed, not settled (P4, P5, V06). The dry run parses all 11 phases.
